responsibility: Provides the shared derive-generation framework used by built-in derives: it models trait impl templates, method signatures, type/field substructures, pattern and field-access construction, and the folding/dispatch logic that trait-specific derive expanders use to build impl ASTs for structs and enums.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `src/deriving/mod.rs`, this `mod.rs` is the internal generic derive engine: it defines the reusable AST-building abstractions (`Substructure`, `FieldInfo`, `CsFold`, pattern/field-access helpers, impl/method template machinery) that individual derives call into, rather than registering derive names or handling top-level expansion entry points.
